hub.title: OT Global Settings
hub.description: Configure shared weather and environment settings used by all rooms.

data_description.weather_entity: Weather entity providing outdoor conditions for all rooms.
data_description.solar_sensor: Optional irradiance sensor. If blank, solar gain is estimated from weather conditions.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Optional dedicated outdoor temperature sensor. If blank, the weather entity is used.
data_description.outdoor_humidity_sensor: Optional dedicated outdoor humidity sensor. If blank, the weather entity is used.
data_description.wind_speed_sensor: Optional dedicated wind speed sensor. If blank, the weather entity is used.
data_description.apparent_temp_entity: Optional sensor providing apparent/RealFeel temperature. When this drops below the reference temperature, correction gain (k) is boosted for all rooms.
data_description.weather_ref_temp: Temperature below which weather severity begins to boost k.
data_description.weather_scale: Range over which severity scales from 0 to 1.
data_description.weather_severity_exponent: Power curve exponent for severity damping.
data_description.smoothing_enabled: Apply exponential smoothing to calculated setpoints across all rooms.
data_description.advanced_sensors: Enable extended diagnostic sensors for every room (MRT detail, coast/rate, weather severity, occupancy). When disabled only core output and basic temperature sensors are created.
data_description.gradient_scale: In ot_referenced mode: the outdoor temperature difference (below desired OT) at which k reaches its configured room value (k_base). Smaller values = more aggressive reduction on mild days.
data_description.gradient_exponent: In ot_referenced mode: power curve shape. 1.0 = linear, 1.5 = moderate curve (recommended), 2.0 = slow start then aggressive.

room.title: OT Room Configuration
room.description: Configure operative temperature control for a room.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this room (used as the config entry title).
data_description.primary_climate: The main climate entity (e.g. ramses_cc zone) whose setpoint will be adjusted.
data_description.backup_climate: Fallback climate entity used when the primary is unavailable.
data_description.air_temp_sensor: Optional dedicated air temperature sensor. If blank, the thermostat's built-in sensor is used.
data_description.room_profile: Describes the room's external wall and window exposure.
data_description.orientation: Compass direction the main window faces, for solar gain calculation.
data_description.occupancy_sensor: Optional binary sensor for room occupancy.
data_description.unoccupied_duration: Minutes the room must be unoccupied before offsets are applied.
data_description.weekday_morning_offset: Temperature offset when unoccupied on weekday mornings (half is applied to desired OT).
data_description.weekday_afternoon_offset: Temperature offset when unoccupied on weekday afternoons (half is applied to desired OT).
data_description.weekday_evening_offset: Temperature offset when unoccupied on weekday evenings (half is applied to desired OT).
data_description.weekend_morning_offset: Temperature offset when unoccupied on weekend mornings (half is applied to desired OT).
data_description.weekend_afternoon_offset: Temperature offset when unoccupied on weekend afternoons (half is applied to desired OT).
data_description.weekend_evening_offset: Temperature offset when unoccupied on weekend evenings (half is applied to desired OT).
data_description.k_adaptation_mode: How correction gain (k) is scaled by outdoor conditions. 'weather_only' uses RealFeel vs a fixed reference temperature. 'ot_referenced' scales k from zero (when outdoors matches target) up to k_base at gradient_scale below target — eliminating the k floor on mild days.
data_description.correction_gain: How aggressively the setpoint is corrected (higher = more correction).
data_description.max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the corrected setpoint.
data_description.override_duration: How long (in minutes) a manual override lasts before automatic control resumes.
data_description.run_interval: How often (in minutes) the control loop runs.
data_description.automation_delay: Seconds to wait before applying setpoint (stagger to avoid bus contention).
data_description.coast_cycles: Number of cycles to look ahead for coasting down as air approaches the target.
data_description.max_step: Maximum setpoint change per cycle (rate limiter).
data_description.time_window_enabled: Restrict control to a daily time window. When disabled, control runs 24/7.
data_description.time_window_start: Start of the daily operating window.
data_description.time_window_end: End of the daily operating window.
data_description.window_sensors: Binary sensors (door/window) that trigger a reduced setpoint when open.
data_description.window_setpoint: Setpoint applied while any window/door sensor is open.
data_description.window_delay: Minutes after all sensors close before reverting to the normal setpoint.
data_description.window_open_delay: Minutes a sensor must be open before the reduced setpoint is applied.
data_description.adjacent_sensors: When any of these sensors are open, this room pauses OT correction and reverts to the scheduled setpoint rather than the corrected setpoint.
